links.outcome: Readability of LLM-simplified Spanish orthopedic patient education materials versus originals, relative to target grade level
links.effect: Simplified PEMs had improved readability versus originals (P<.001) but did not reach the targeted grade level; GPT-4 also significantly reduced complexity of Spanish medical text (P<.001).
links.quote: Simplified PEMs demonstrated improved readability when compared to original versions (P<.001) but were unable to reach the targeted grade level for simplification.

unlisted_practices: Using Google Translate for translation and GPT-4 for simplification (dual approach) of Spanish patient education materials
BLEU-based comparison of machine translation against professional human translation

screen.reason: Evaluates translation and readability simplification of orthopedic patient education materials by GPT-4 and Google Translate using BLEU scores and readability metrics.
